senses.gloss: ch. same, to cry, bleat, low. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 (3) אימרין פַּעְיִין the lambs bleated.—
units: <cite ref="Chullin 43a:12">Ḥull. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>וושט אכלא ביה ופָעְיָא ביה</he> the œsophagus which is affected when the animal eats and also when it lows (or breathes, Rashi).
Bekh. 35ᵃ פָּעֵי ומיחזי if the animal has a defect in its mouth which is seen, when it opens its mouth; a. e.—Esp. to be noisy, protest.
<cite ref="Chullin 133b:4">Ḥull. 133ᵇ</cite> <he>סתם כותי מִפְעָא פָעֵי</he> the gentile partner usually makes himself heard (when the Jewish partner is selling).
<cite ref="Arakhin 6b:16">Arakh. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>עכו״ם הוא דפעי</he> the gentile will protest (when the object which he dedicated is diverted from its use).
<cite ref="Eruvin 75b:12">Erub. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>אי איתא דאוגר מיפעא פעי</he> if he had rented it out, he would have talked of it; a. e.
